findings.text: an unlisted capable edge route: bind_sources_exclusively does OPTIONAL MATCH (source)-[prior:PRODUCED_NAME]->(:StandardName) DELETE prior then MERGE (source)-[:PRODUCED_NAME]->(sn) with no predicate on the old target's name_stage, so a source that is an accepted name's only producer can be rebound and leave it orphaned; provenance_rebuild.py:687 calls it with enforce_consistency=False, and detach-route-audit.md:39-57 does not list it.

an unlisted sixth member of the signed-manifest family: _apply_ordinary_source_migration DELETEs the source's prior PRODUCED_NAME edge and CREATEs it on the new target, _ordinary_source_migration_refusal (2779-2786) checks that the NEW target is accepted and valid and never the old target's stage, and when the old target loses its last producer the migration completes anyway, writing old.source_paths = [] at 4445-4470, so the "largest single class (five routes)" claim at detach-route-audit.md:59 understates the family.

the census re-derives only counts over a hardcoded twenty-four-tuple SITES list; it cannot discover an unlisted site, so detach-route-audit.md:27's "Re-derive with python3 route_census.py" advertises a check that would reproduce 24/19/5 unchanged over the two missing routes above and would have passed with EXIT=0.

an unlisted node-deletion route reachable from the operator CLI: sn prune --include-sources issues MATCH (sns:StandardNameSource) {where_clause} DETACH DELETE sns where the where_clause is built only from --source and --ids (5650-5660) and never from the stage filter, so "sn prune --stage drafted --include-sources" deletes every StandardNameSource node, including producers of names outside the deleted stage, while the confirmation at 5630 names only the StandardName count; the census ROOT at route_census.py:12 is imas_codex/standard_names and the audit states no boundary, so this route is neither listed nor excluded.

the stated re-derivation evidence is not durable: route_census.py and live_graph_census.py exist only in the run envelope and are not committed, so a run-envelope GC or a fresh clone leaves the line-27 instruction unsatisfiable, and the claim here that "Both contain the script that produced them" overstates live-graph-census.log, which holds only its JSON result.

justifications.durability: the audit, the plan comment, and the archive anchor are all present in the committed HEAD (02e58ec98) with a clean worktree, but detach-route-audit.md:27 and :214 instruct re-derivation with route_census.py and live_graph_census.py, which exist only in the run envelope under ~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/ and are attached to neither the commit nor a durable store, so a run-envelope GC leaves the instruction unsatisfiable, and line 254's claim that "Both contain the script that produced them" does not hold for live-graph-census.log, which holds only its JSON result.
justifications.evidence: live-graph-census.log:104-117 carries coverage plus positive controls (5,493 PRODUCED_NAME edges across 5,393 distinct sources, 5,130/5,130 identity keys) so the orphan count of 9 is demonstrably from a live-reading instrument, and detach-route-audit.md:37-57 quotes each predicate verbatim so every classification is independently checkable, but the re-derivation instrument route_census.py:17-42 hardcodes the twenty-four SITES list and can only recount it, and manifest.md's "final_delta: 3 files, +372/-7 vs fcc65951b" disagrees with git diff fcc65951bc52d083b74461f10ffbfe39b97c2624..02e58ec98, which measures +372/-0.
justifications.fit: detach-route-audit.md:1-14 states the read-only method and the revision audited, the record lands in the plan's evidence home with an archive anchor and a plan comment that resolves no followup, the decision diagram is inline SVG rather than a new asset path, and the naming checks ran over the staged paths before staging.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/unbound-source-backlog/detach-route-audit.md:27 states "Thirteen of the nineteen edge routes and one node route can take an accepted name's last producer, so fourteen sites", but two capable edge routes in the same imas_codex/standard_names surface are unlisted — provenance_lifecycle.py:1043 bind_sources_exclusively (DELETE prior, no stage predicate on the old target) and signed_manifest.py:4439 _apply_ordinary_source_migration (DELETE prior, old target's stage never read; the refusal at 2779-2786 checks only the NEW target) — so the headline capable count of fourteen is understated to at least seventeen, while every other done-when item (the detach refusal and its two holes at 85-146, the liveness confirmation at 148-172, the rename answer at 174-210, and the live 9-vs-bound-9 census at 212-232) is delivered as written.
justifications.scope_discipline: manifest.md:3 declares exactly three documentation paths and git log fcc65951bc52d083b74461f10ffbfe39b97c2624..02e58ec98 shows three commits whose union diff is exactly those three files (detach-route-audit.md new at 255 lines, unbound-source-backlog-landed.html +104, unbound-source-backlog.html +13), with a clean worktree and no source, test, generated, or unrelated file in any commit.
